Alpine Components License

You MAY use these components in your personal and professional projects. As an employee or as a freelancer.

You MAY NOT share your access login.

You MAY NOT re-distribute these components either directly or indirectly as part of a paid or open-source project.

An example of proper usage: copy and pasting a modal component into your web application.

An example of NOT proper usage: Buying one access license and sharing it with your dev team. Each developer must have their own paid access.

An example of NOT proper usage: building a competing project that offers UI componentry and would be used as an alternative to Alpine Components inside of an application.
